privileged_info_for_vlm: 1TTA is the wild-type TTR; 1TTC is the V30M mutant. Residue 30 is located in the hydrophobic core. Surrounding residues (within 4.5A) typically include Leu17, Val20, Ala25, Val121, and Leu110. The distance between 1TTA Val30 CG1 and 1TTC Met30 CE is approximately 1.8 to 2.2 Angstroms depending on the alignment. The V30M mutation causes steric strain/clash due to the larger Methionine sidechain replacing Valine, which destabilizes the TTR tetramer.
